Is it all one validator abstracted by one index? * If a slashing committed by SSV (if preventative measures fail), does it mean the whole group of the SSV gets slashed? Is this an error? https://github.com/alonmuroch/prysm/blob/88f2b2e25ecaee0df108533134d99dd4c9d2ee8c/slasher/detection/detect.go#L219 This call `GetDuties` has to be optimized. Calling `GetDuties` on every "partial" attestation is very slow and won't work in case of many validators. https://github.com/prysmaticlabs/prysm/compare/develop...alonmuroch:ssv#diff-5674756280c70dbd14773c3f1bfa41f30db23afe568d8f3c1cbc761e04c49ea1R88 I see `ssvnode` works only with a single validator. Are there any plans to scale it on, say, 100 validators per process? on what branch are you on? seems really old yeah for sure, a single SSV should be able to manage lots of validators Hi <@!103118784230866944> * link to our current test ssv validator: https://pyrmont.beaconcha.in/validator/b4dbeb61df8d810ff7c3d319716c867ac8d717ac6037413e66f543ec031fd23f10d58cf0f94831ec4963b9dc6d6555ad#attestations * How do SSVs look in Beacon Chain's perspective? Is it all one validator abstracted by one index? yep thats correct, its transparent to the BC * If a slashing committed by SSV (if preventative measures fail), does it mean the whole group of the SSV gets slashed? not sure what you mean here, if one SSV node is "faulty" then the IBFT mechanism either won’t reach consensus (not submitted to BC) or will reach it without it (if there are enough other SSV nodes) <@!103118784230866944> that is not the SSV repository . This is the correct one: https://github.com/bloxapp/ssv

excerpts.author: deni64k
excerpts.content:
Hi there! A few questions:
* Can you share links to those SSVs running on Pyrmont?
* How do SSVs look in Beacon Chain's perspective? Is it all one validator abstracted by one index?
* If a slashing committed by SSV (if preventative measures fail), does it mean the whole group of the SSV gets slashed?

excerpts.author: deni64k
excerpts.content:
This call `GetDuties` has to be optimized. Calling `GetDuties` on every "partial" attestation is very slow and won't work in case of many validators.
https://github.com/prysmaticlabs/prysm/compare/develop...alonmuroch:ssv#diff-5674756280c70dbd14773c3f1bfa41f30db23afe568d8f3c1cbc761e04c49ea1R88

excerpts.author: deni64k
excerpts.content: I see `ssvnode` works only with a single validator. Are there any plans to scale it on, say, 100 validators per process?

excerpts.author: alon.ssv.network
excerpts.content: on what branch are you on? seems really old

excerpts.author: alon.ssv.network
excerpts.content: yeah for sure, a single SSV should be able to manage lots of validators
